generation: Built-in image generation, using the source PNG as visual reference. These are concept illustrations, not model renders or verified parameter extremes.

sheets.prompt: Seven panels showing the reference character's head and neck in neutral and yaw, pitch and roll extremes, preserving identity, colors and anime style.
sheets.review: Draft only: generated profiles substantially exceed and do not quantify the model's parameter ranges; feature placement and hidden areas are speculative.

sheets.prompt: Seven upper-body panels based on the reference showing neutral and body yaw, pitch and roll, with the crop retained and no invented lower body.
sheets.review: Rejected as a body-motion target: head direction changes dominate the sheet and torso rotations are not clearly demonstrated or quantified.

sheets.prompt: Four close-up reference panels showing hair roots, jaw-neck, collar-shoulder, and sleeve-arm connections on the original upper-body character.
sheets.review: Draft only: plausible illustrations, but not separated hidden layers and not evidence of coverage while animated. The cropped source contains no waist, skirt or legs.

parameterExtremes: Not calibrated: the generated images do not encode measurable StandRig values.
acceptanceChecks: Confirm panel order and intended parameter values
Preserve character identity and original artwork
Verify hidden artwork and overlap at every visible joint
Check eye clipping and draw order
Render actual model at neutral, extremes and combined poses
Reject holes, detached parts, smearing and unreviewed perspective changes
blockingGaps: No accepted calibrated head/body target sheets
No source artwork for full-body and lower-body connections
No separate eyelids or mouth interior
No validated animated poses or visual review
